sections.note: two stacked empty full-width bands directly above footer

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width [bg:gradient] or [bg:image] zone with zero captured child text, positioned as the last content zone immediately above the footer.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction as a likely CTA banner (heading+button) rather than silently applying decorative-graphics-are-noise.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs across page-10/page-11 templates in the same position with a reserved height, suggesting real CTA copy that failed to render at capture width. Rejected alternative: treating it as pure decoration and dropping it.

provenance.evidence: C109 rc1c2c7 [bg:image] 1280x281 and rc1c2c8 [bg:gradient] 1280x507, both childless, stacked directly above footer rc2

proposed_rules.trigger: A [bg:color] node whose width is roughly double the page's captured viewport width (e.g. 2560 vs 1280) and whose y-range overlaps a card-grid section.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold into the section style of the overlapping card-grid section (background-container-is-section-style); do not list as separate content or a separate section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Width doubling indicates the extractor captured an underlying full-bleed background layer independent of the viewport crop, not a real 2560px-wide element on the live site.

provenance.evidence: C109 rc3/rc4/rc5 [bg:color] @0,831 / 0,1879 / 0,2959 2560x1676 overlapping rc1c2c3/c4/c5 card grids
